This is a Transformers movie-themed portfolio website with the following specifications:

## Theme Requirements
- Dark background with metallic/industrial aesthetics
- 3D robotic animations and effects
- Metallic sound effects on button interactions
- Holographic effects for profile photo
- Loading screen with rotating gears forming a cube
- Futuristic UI elements with glowing neon accents

## Technologies Used
- React with Vite
- Three.js for 3D graphics and animations
- Framer Motion for smooth animations
- Styled Components for theming
- Modern CSS for visual effects

## Key Features
1. Immersive Transformers-themed visual design
2. Interactive 3D elements and animations
3. Holographic profile photo effect
4. AI chatbot for user assistance
5. Responsive design with mobile optimization
6. Sound effects for enhanced user experience

When generating code, prioritize:
- Performance optimization for 3D elements
- Accessibility considerations
- Mobile responsiveness
- Modern React patterns and hooks
- Clean, modular component architecture
